test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The boy looked **__disheveled__** and lost.
solution:
The correct answer is "Tidy."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disheveled"** means (used about a person’s appearance) very untidy. (किसी व्यक्ति की शक्ल-सूरत के बारे में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है) Example: *He ran in looking hot and **disheveled**__.*
 
• The antonym of "Disheveled" is "Tidy."
 
• The word "Tidy" means arranged with everything in good order. (हर चीज़ को अच्छे क्रम में व्यवस्थित किया गया।)
 __
 
• Example: *If you keep your room **tidy**__ it is easier to find things.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Clumsy: **(used about a person) careless and likely to knock into, drop or break things. ((व्‍यक्ति) लापरवाह और बेढंगे तरीक़े से काम करने वाला; फूहड़, भद्दा)
 
• **Infuriated: **to make somebody very angry. (किसी को बहुत क्रोधित करना।)
 
• **Excited: **feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm; not calm.(खुशी और उत्साह महसूस करना या दिखाना; शांत नहीं है)
